verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Square publishes an llms.txt (HTTP 200). That file explicitly targets AI agents: it carries 'For agents' guidance, points to a full llms-full.txt corpus, and advises agents to fetch only relevant API links. Docs pages also render as raw markdown via a .md suffix (e.g., graphql.md, mcp.md, access-tokens.md). Missing for 10: consistent .md coverage (the root docs.md probe returned 404) and independent or community corroboration of agents consuming these docs in practice.
